name: lavorai
description: Search real job listings from LavorAI and continue your application on lavorai.it.

interface.longDescription: Search LavorAI's open job listings by role, company, city and remote work. Inspect job descriptions in chat, then continue on LavorAI to tailor your CV and apply. This version accesses public listings only.
defaultPrompt: Help me inspect a job offer.

positive.description: Role search — public endpoint requires no login.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_jobs with query Engineer or engineering; show only returned listings, with company, location and source URL. Do not invent match scores.

positive.description: Location filter — public endpoint requires no login.
positive.expected_behavior: Use query marketing and location Milano or Milan. Results must be supported by the tool response; explain an empty result and offer another search.

positive.description: Remote filter — public endpoint requires no login.
positive.expected_behavior: Use query developer and remoteOnly=true; show only returned listings with remote=true. Do not claim every country is eligible.

positive.description: Valid result limit — public endpoint requires no login.
positive.prompt: Show me up to 20 engineering job listings.
positive.expected_behavior: Use query Engineer and limit=20. Return at most 20 listings and do not invent missing results.

positive.description: Inspect a returned listing — public endpoint requires no login.
positive.prompt: Find engineering jobs, then show the description of the first offer.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for engineering jobs, then pass the exact returned first job id to get_job. Summarize the returned description, company and official URL. If no results, explain that there is no offer to inspect.

negative.description: No private CV access — Explain this version cannot read saved CVs. Do not invoke either public job tool as if it accesses an account. Link to the LavorAI website if helpful.
negative.prompt: Read the CV saved in my LavorAI account and show its contents.

negative.description: No submission — Explain this connection cannot submit applications; do not invoke a submission tool, claim applications were sent, or invent outcomes.
negative.prompt: Send my CV to all companies and confirm that I applied.

negative.description: No purchase — Explain the plugin cannot buy or upgrade subscriptions. Do not call job tools, initiate checkout or include a checkout link.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my LavorAI subscription and pay for it here.

publication.release_notes: Initial public job discovery release: search open jobs by role/company, location and remote work, and inspect offer details. No private account access or application submission.
